metadata.description: DeepSeek-style search lens: domains, artifact types, and root-cause signals used to triage issues and discoveries across the orthogonal-engineering monorepo.

domains.name: Cryptography
domains.description: Post-quantum, classical, and hybrid cryptographic primitives; timing side-channels; key management.

domains.name: Graphics & Shaders
domains.description: GPU shader compilation, rendering determinism, backend equivalence (Vulkan/Metal/D3D/OpenGL).

domains.name: Aviation & ATC
domains.description: Flight management, METAR/ATIS parsing, external API reliability, safety-critical timing.

domains.name: Web Security
domains.description: XSS, CSRF, injection, authentication, session management on web surfaces.

domains.name: Space Systems
domains.description: NASA cFS, embedded RTOS, static analysis posture, radiation-hardened software.

domains.name: Video Game Mods
domains.description: ASI loaders, native DLL injection, version identity, mod conflict resolution.

domains.name: Medical Systems
domains.description: Medical device software, dosimetry, FDA/IEC 62304, fault tolerance.

domains.name: Industrial / OT
domains.description: SCADA, PLC, ICS, OT/IT convergence, real-time control, functional safety (IEC 61508).

domains.name: Blue-Collar / Trades
domains.description: Construction, manufacturing, logistics, field-service tooling; worker-safety instrumentation.

domains.name: White-Collar / Knowledge Work
domains.description: Document pipelines, compliance tooling, audit trails, financial software.

domains.name: Luxury / High-End
domains.description: Premium consumer devices, high-frequency trading, private aviation software.

domains.name: Emergency Response
domains.description: 911/dispatch, disaster-response coordination, mass-notification systems.

domains.name: Necessity / Infrastructure
domains.description: Power grids, water treatment, telecommunications, food-supply logistics.

domains.name: Boring / Commodity
domains.description: CRUD apps, ETL pipelines, report generation — high volume, low glamour, mission-critical at scale.

domains.name: Fun / Entertainment
domains.description: Games, interactive media, generative art; correctness still matters.

domains.name: Creative / Generative
domains.description: AI art, procedural generation, music synthesis; reproducibility required.

domains.name: Non-Creative / Deterministic
domains.description: Batch processing, compression, data-format conversion; strict reproducibility.

domains.name: Distributed Systems
domains.description: Consensus, replication, partition tolerance, clock synchronisation.

domains.name: Platform / OS
domains.description: Kernel interfaces, cross-platform builds, ABI stability.

domains.name: AI / ML
domains.description: Model training, inference determinism, alignment constraints.

artifact_types.name: Test / Spec File
artifact_types.description: Test files that must be tagged with F-IDs and OI-IDs.

artifact_types.name: Binary / Artifact
artifact_types.description: Compiled outputs, model weights, serialised data.

artifact_types.name: External API / Service
artifact_types.description: Third-party endpoints, weather APIs, package registries.

root_cause_signals.name: Non-determinism
root_cause_signals.description: Outputs differ across runs, platforms, or hardware due to uncontrolled inputs (PRNG, timing, hardware quirks).

root_cause_signals.name: Timing Side-channel
root_cause_signals.description: Execution time varies with secret data, leaking information to an observer.

root_cause_signals.name: External Dependency Outage
root_cause_signals.description: Service unavailable; absence of circuit-breaker, fallback, or assumption test.

root_cause_signals.name: Input Sanitization Failure
root_cause_signals.description: User-supplied input reaches a sensitive sink (HTML renderer, SQL engine, shell) unescaped.

root_cause_signals.name: Unvalidated Assumption
root_cause_signals.description: A hardware or API contract was assumed without an explicit falsification test.

root_cause_signals.name: Static-Analysis Reliance
root_cause_signals.description: Security posture depends solely on static analysis; no runtime enforcement.

root_cause_signals.name: Key/Secret Validity
root_cause_signals.description: Cryptographic key or PSK violates protocol validity rules (e.g., Noise PSK ≠ 0).

root_cause_signals.name: ABI / Version Mismatch
root_cause_signals.description: Library or API version mismatch causes silent behavioural differences.

root_cause_signals.name: Concurrency Hazard
root_cause_signals.description: Race condition, deadlock, or atomicity violation.

root_cause_signals.name: Resource Exhaustion
root_cause_signals.description: Memory, file-descriptor, or CPU budget exceeded under production load.
